stories.title: California Sues OpenAI Over A.I. Safety Issues
stories.summary: California's attorney general has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that the company has not implemented sufficient safeguards for its artificial intelligence technology. The lawsuit claims that this lack of protection poses a risk to the public.

stories.title: Madison Huang, Jensen Huang’s Daughter, Became a Powerful Force at Nvidia
stories.summary: Madison Huang, daughter of Jensen Huang, reportedly became a significant figure at Nvidia, serving as her father's de facto chief of staff. Her presence caused issues with senior executives, and her continued involvement now presents a challenge for the interim C.E.O.

stories.title: Hackers Target 178 Popular Websites: How Your Credit Card Details And iPhone Could Be At Risk
stories.summary: Hackers exploited a weakness in Optimizely to insert harmful code into numerous popular websites, including those associated with CNN, Zoom, HSBC, and IKEA. This attack aimed to compromise visitors' cryptocurrency wallets, payment card information, and Apple devices.

stories.title: Accenture LearnVantage, Google Cloud partner to bring AI learning to 1,000+ Indian institutions
stories.summary: Accenture LearnVantage and Google Cloud are partnering to provide artificial intelligence learning opportunities to over 1,000 institutions in India.

stories.title: Meta Changes Instagram In India, You Will Now See Less Violent And Sexually Suggestive Content
stories.summary: Meta has updated Instagram's recommendation system in India, utilizing advanced AI to decrease the amount of violent and sexually suggestive content users see. These changes will alter the content displayed in users' feeds.

stories.title: Nvidia’s Earnings Call Is a High-Stakes Moment
stories.summary: Wall Street is anticipating Nvidia's upcoming earnings call to gain insight into the artificial intelligence giant's future direction. Analysts are looking for information that will help them understand the company's prospects.

stories.title: Trump’s New A.I. Chip Rules Rattle Southeast Asia
stories.summary: New U.S. restrictions on A.I. chips are causing concern in Southeast Asia, potentially impacting billions in investments. Countries in the region may face challenges in balancing their relationships with both Washington and Beijing due to these new rules.

stories.title: Elon Musk’s Texas GOP Allies, Who Gave Him $1.7 Billion, Have Been Voted Out. What Now?
stories.summary: Elon Musk's political allies in Texas, who supported him with significant funds, have been voted out of office. This development raises questions about the future of SpaceX and Tesla, which are deeply established in Texas after Mr. Musk moved his operations from California in 2020.

stories.title: Tata Stocks Rally Up To 9% As RBI Pushes Tata Sons To Meet Listing Norms
stories.summary: Shares of Tata Group companies rose by as much as 9% after the Reserve Bank of India reminded Tata Sons about meeting listing regulations for upper-layer non-banking financial companies. This reminder prompted a positive market reaction for the conglomerate's stocks.

stories.title: India's Air Passenger Traffic Likely To Cross 500 Million By 2030, India Could Become Global SAF Supplier: Aviation Minister
stories.summary: India's aviation minister predicts that air passenger traffic in the country will likely exceed 500 million by 2030, and India could become a global supplier of sustainable aviation fuel. The country is developing a policy for sustainable aviation fuel to reduce emissions, support farmers, and foster a green energy sector.

stories.title: Exclusive: US intel indicates Iran developing plans to potentially detonate a dirty bomb in Washington, sources say
stories.summary: US intelligence suggests that Iran may be planning to detonate a dirty bomb in Washington. This information comes from sources familiar with the intelligence findings.

stories.title: Trump Administration Divide on China Policy Breaks Into Public View
stories.summary: A disagreement within the Trump administration regarding China policy has become publicly apparent. This internal conflict, highlighted by a dispute over advanced A.I. chips, reveals growing divisions within the government as President Trump prepares for an important meeting with his Chinese counterpart.

stories.title: Ground Stops and Dirty Bombs: America's Latest Security Concerns
stories.summary: America is currently facing new security concerns, including issues related to ground stops and the potential threat of dirty bombs.

stories.title: 'Azam Khan will get justice': Akhilesh Yadav welcomes SC relief to SP leader in fake birth certificate ca
stories.summary: Akhilesh Yadav has expressed that Azam Khan will receive justice, following the Supreme Court's decision to grant relief to the SP leader in a fake birth certificate case.

stories.title: Trump's 'Tough Guy' Praise For PM Modi Before Quad Meet On Sidelines of ASEAN
stories.summary: President Trump praised Prime Minister Modi, referring to him as a 'tough guy,' ahead of the Quad meeting that took place on the sidelines of ASEAN.

stories.title: Good News For International Students In US: Court Scraps 4-Year Visa Limit, Retains Flexible Stay Rules
stories.summary: A court has removed the four-year visa limit for international students in the US, while keeping flexible stay rules in place. This decision is beneficial for international students as it allows them to remain in the country for the duration of their academic programs without a strict time constraint.

stories.title: US proposes overhaul of Green Card sponsorship rules for foreign workers
stories.summary: The US is suggesting changes to the rules for sponsoring foreign workers for Green Cards. This could impact how foreign workers obtain permanent residency in the country.

stories.title: US Offers 15-Day Premium Processing for 27 Visa Categories, Indians to Benefit
stories.summary: The US is now offering a 15-day premium processing option for 27 different visa categories, which will be advantageous for applicants from India. This new service allows for faster processing of certain visa applications.

stories.title: Fewer international students are choosing US colleges. Here’s what’s driving the drop
stories.summary: Fewer international students are choosing to attend colleges in the US, and there are several factors contributing to this decline. This trend indicates a shift in international student enrollment patterns in American higher education.

stories.title: Barnard pauses international student work authorizations for spring 2027, Rosado announces
stories.summary: Barnard College has temporarily stopped processing work authorizations for international students for the spring 2027 semester. This announcement from Rosado indicates a change in policy regarding employment opportunities for international students at the institution.
